text:
I've been to this clinic before for fillings (3-4 teeth), a cracked molar, and a scaling. I had a problem with the last filling; I experienced slight sensitivity after returning home. The dentist scheduled a follow-up appointment, but I didn't have time.
This time, I had two more fillings done. Shortly after returning home, after eating certain foods, both teeth became highly sensitive. I called the clinic, and they scheduled an appointment for the same day. The dentist fixed it, but it seemed to make things worse. After the first fix, the sensitivity at the necks of both teeth was significantly worse. They immediately did a second fix and told me to try it out. When I got home and looked in the mirror, I was appalled. Why were my teeth so long? Where did my gums go? My gums and cheeks were very painful. I couldn't do anything. The next day, everything I ate caused bleeding and pain in the gum area of ​​the filled teeth, and the sensitivity at the necks of both teeth was excruciating. This filling job was terrible; it felt like they lacked skill or were unhappy with the result. My teeth and gums are now crooked. Is it even possible to fix the fillings and gums I had done?
